name: Warsong Runner Update
summary: Runners carry word through Ashenvale as the Warsong Clan faces growing pressure along the border. Their report warns commanders of increasingly bold naga attacks on Horde outposts.

sections.title: Frontline Dispatches
sections.body: Warsong scouts and runners watch the fighting across Ashenvale and keep supply lines open. They face night elf sentinels and the dangers of the forest, so commanders need word from the frontier quickly. Couriers carry dispatches to remote garrisons and commanders such as Kadrak at the Mor'shan Rampart.

sections.title: The Naga Threat
sections.body: Horde defenders expect to face night elves among the trees, but outpost sentries report bolder attacks by naga. The serpentine invaders strike from waterways and ancient ruins, testing the barricades and drawing defenders away from forest and border patrols. The dispatch to the Mor'shan Rampart warns of these coordinated attacks from the water.

faq.q: Who is the report being sent to?
faq.answer: The report goes to Kadrak, an overseer at the Mor'shan Rampart on the border between Ashenvale and the northern Barrens.

faq.q: What threats are mentioned in the update?
faq.answer: The scout reports repeated assaults on the local outpost and an escalating threat from hostile naga in nearby waters.

faq.q: Why does the Horde rely on foot runners here?
faq.answer: Dense foliage, night elf marksmen, and isolated outposts make flight difficult or dangerous across parts of Ashenvale. Runners carry messages quickly and discreetly along guarded paths.
Warsong Runners are scouts, couriers, and vanguard fighters of the Warsong Clan. They protect supply lines and watch enemy movements along the forest's contested borders.

faq.q: Where are the naga attacking in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: Naga attack from strongholds in ruins along Ashenvale's shores and lakes, ambushing travelers and raiding nearby camps.

faq.q: What is the outpost's purpose in this area?
faq.answer: The outpost warns of danger and anchors the defenses, guarding communication between lumber operations deep in the forest and the Barrens.

angles.text: Along the forest frontier, every soldier counts. Keeping communication open between the Barrens and forward outposts is vital to survival.
As an orc, you know the Warsong Clan depends on its runners' grit and watchfulness to hold ground claimed under Warchief Thrall's command.
